blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generative image compression (GIC) delivers strong perceptual quality at low bitrates. However, GIC methods with strong perceptual quality often rely on pretrained diffusion models with high latency, while recent lightweight GIC methods reduce latency but deliver lower perceptual quality. We observe that, for lightweight GIC methods at low bitrates, coarse deterministic quantization can collapse nearby encoder latents corresponding to different fine details to the same point, making these details difficult to recover. Motivated by this, we propose GR-GIC, an efficient GIC that delivers competitive reconstruction performance with fast inference. For better performance, we introduce Guided Refinement (GR), which combines latent refinement guided by entropy context with adaptive perturbations for training regularization, jointly improving reconstruction at low bitrates. For fast inference, we introduce reorganized projected residual vector quantization (P-RVQ), which equivalently reorganizes residual updates into low-dimensional lookups to expose greater parallelism and reduce sequential computation. Experiments on Kodak show that for performance, compared with OneDC, GR-GIC achieves BD-rate savings of 23.19%, 37.71%, 22.30%, and 22.14% for LPIPS, DISTS, PSNR, and FID, respectively. For fast inference, the highly optimized implementation of GR-GIC encodes and decodes in 4.60 and 5.98 ms on an NVIDIA A100. Specifically, the reorganized P-RVQ implementation achieves a $3.14\times$ average speedup over the original implementation under the same FP32 setting. On an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX, GR-GIC achieves latency comparable to lightweight GIC methods.

blocks.en:
Generative image compression (GIC) provides strong perceptual reconstruction at low bitrates.
This is challenging for traditional codecs and learned image codecs optimized primarily for pixel fidelity, which tend to smooth textures and weaken fine details as the bitrate decreases [ 40 , 24 , 3 , 28 ] .
GIC addresses this limitation with adversarial generators [ 31 , 33 ] , discrete generative representations [ 34 , 41 ] , or diffusion priors [ 8 , 47 , 42 ] , whose learned priors can synthesize plausible details that are not fully specified by the compressed representation.
blocks.zh:
基因图像压缩(GIC)在低比特率下提供强烈的知觉重建.
这对传统的解码器和学习到的图像解码器具有挑战性,这些解码器主要用于像素忠贞,随着比特率的降低[40,24,3,28],它们倾向于平滑纹理,削弱细细的细节.
GIC通过对抗发生器[31,33],离散的基因表达[34,41],或扩散前传[8,47,42]来解决这一限制,其学习的前传可以合成压缩前传未充分说明的可信细节.

blocks.en:
However, high-performing GIC methods often rely on pretrained diffusion models, whose large parameter counts and FLOPs hinder practical deployment [ 18 , 47 , 42 , 36 ] .
To address this issue, recent work has explored lightweight GIC methods with fewer parameters and faster inference [ 7 , 6 , 22 ] , but their reconstruction performance still leaves room for improvement compared with diffusion-based methods.
This leaves a trade-off between reconstruction performance and fast inference.
blocks.zh:
然而,高业绩 GIC方法经常依赖预先训练的传播模型,其大参数计数和FLOP阻碍实际部署[18,47,42,36].
为了解决这一问题,最近的工作以较少的参数和更快的推论[7,6,22]探索了轻量级GIC方法,但与基于传播的方法相比,其重建性能仍有改进的余地.
这就在重建绩效与快速推论之间留有权衡余地.

blocks.en:
We observe that, in lightweight GIC methods, images with similar coarse content but different fine details can be mapped to nearby points in the continuous latent space.
At low bitrates, coarse deterministic quantization can collapse these distinct latents to the same quantized point, making their fine detail differences unavailable from the quantized representation, as illustrated in Figures 1 and 1 .
By contrast, diffusion based methods introduce diversity through Gaussian noise and use strong generative priors to synthesize plausible details, providing a natural mechanism to compensate for this uncertainty.
blocks.zh:
我们观察到,在轻量级的GIC方法中,具有类似粗细内容但细微细节的图像可以在连续潜在空间中映射到附近的点.
如图1和图1所示,在低比特率下,粗细的确定性量化可以使这些独特的潜在值崩溃到相同的量化点,使其细微的差别无法与量化的表示值相比。
相比之下,基于扩散的方法通过高斯噪声引入多样性,并使用强烈的基因前传来合成可信细节,为弥补这种不确定性提供了自然机制.

blocks.en:
Motivated by this observation, we propose GR-GIC , an efficient GIC that combines competitive reconstruction performance with fast inference, as shown in Figure 1 .
For better performance, we introduce Guided Refinement (GR), which uses entropy context to parameterize a Gaussian refinement distribution around the recovered latent.
Its mean shifts the recovered latent toward a refined center, while its variance controls adaptive perturbations for training regularization, jointly improving reconstruction at low bitrates.
For fast inference, we target projected residual vector quantization (P-RVQ), which is a major encoder latency bottleneck in EF-LIC [ 6 ] .
We derive an algebraically equivalent reorganization that replaces serial high dimensional residual updates with low dimensional lookups, exposing greater parallelism and reducing sequential computation.

基于这一观察,我们提出GR-GIC,一个高效的GIC,将竞争性重建业绩与快速推论相结合,如图1所示。
为了更好的性能,我们引入了Guided Finement(GR),它使用 en语上下文来参数化高斯语精细分布在回收的潜伏物周围.
其含义是将恢复的潜质转移到精细中心,而其差异则控制培训正规化的适应性干扰,共同改善低比特率的重建。
就快速推论而言,我们的目标是预测的剩余矢量量化(P-RVQ),这是EF-LC[6]中的一个主要编码时滞瓶颈。
我们得出了代数等效的重组,以低维的查看取代序列高维的剩余更新,暴露出更大的平行性,减少顺序计算.

blocks.en:
Experiments on Kodak show that (i) for performance, compared with OneDC [ 42 ] , GR-GIC achieves BD-rate [ 5 ] savings of 23.19%, 37.71%, 22.30%, and 22.14% for LPIPS [ 45 ] , DISTS [ 11 ] , PSNR, and FID [ 19 ] , respectively.
(ii) For fast inference, the highly optimized implementation of GR-GIC encodes and decodes in 4.60 and 5.98 ms on an NVIDIA A100, achieving 16.73 × 16.73\times and 34.19 × 34.19\times speedups over the official OneDC implementation, respectively.
Specifically, the reorganized P-RVQ implementation achieves a 3.14 × 3.14\times average speedup over the original implementation under the same FP32 setting.
We further validate GR-GIC on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX, where it achieves latency comparable to existing lightweight GIC methods, supporting its deployment on edge devices.

(二)对于快速推论,在NVIDIA A100上,高度优化了GR-GIC编码和解码在4.60和5.98ms中的执行,分别实现了16.73×16.73\时和34.19×34.19时的速度超过OneDC正式执行.
具体来说,经过重组的P-RVQ实施在相同的FP32设定下,比最初实施的平均速度达到3.14×3.14\时.
我们进一步在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上验证GR-GIC,在那里它实现了与现有轻量级GIC方法相当的耐久性,支持其在边缘装置上的部署.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Diffusion models provide strong generative priors for reconstructing details that are not fully specified by compressed representations [ 43 , 8 ] .
Recent GIC methods increasingly use pretrained diffusion models and improve their efficiency through fewer diffusion steps, one-step reconstruction, or lighter architectures [ 29 , 47 , 18 , 42 , 22 ] .
Despite these advances, their model size and computation remain substantial for efficient deployment.
blocks.zh:
扩散模型为重建未经压缩表达法充分说明的细节提供了强大的基因前传[43,8].
最近的GIC方法越来越多地使用预先训练的传播模型,并通过较少的传播步骤、一步重建或较轻的建筑[29、47、18、42、22]来提高其效率。
尽管取得了这些进展,但它们的模型规模和计算仍然相当大,有利于有效部署。

blocks.en:
VAE-based GIC provides a more efficient alternative through adversarial priors, improved latent representations, and vector quantization [ 31 , 33 , 21 , 26 , 41 , 23 ] .
Recent work further develops lightweight GIC.
ProGIC combines a depthwise convolutional backbone with RVQ [ 7 ] , while EF-LIC models correlations among latents in the representation domain [ 6 ] . GR-GIC builds on EF-LIC, introducing GR for better reconstruction and reorganizing P-RVQ to move high dimensional reconstruction outside the sequential search path.
blocks.zh:
基于VAE的GIC通过对抗性前科,改进潜在表述,以及矢量定量[31,33,21,26,41,23]提供了更有效的替代品.
最近的工作进一步发展了轻量级GIC.
ProGIC将一个深度的演化骨干与RVQ[7]结合,而EF-LIC模型则在代表域的潜伏物之间相互关联[6]. GR-GIC以EF-LIC为基础,采用GR来更好地重建,并重组P-RVQ,将高维度重建移到顺序搜索路径之外.

blocks.en:
Prior LIC methods have compensated quantization loss through latent residual prediction, post-quantization filtering, and adaptive quantization or correction [ 32 , 15 , 48 , 16 ] .
Recent work also studies latent and noise compensation [ 44 ] .
These methods mainly perform deterministic correction using decoder context, rely on guidance from the encoder for content-adaptive compensation, or model stochastic compensation without adapting it to context.
In contrast, GR uses entropy context already available at the decoder to parameterize a refinement distribution that adapts to spatial location and image content, without additional payload, while adaptive perturbations provide training regularization for generative reconstruction.
blocks.zh:

最近的工作还研究潜在和噪音补偿[44]。
这些方法主要使用解码器上下文来进行决定性的校正,依靠编码器的指导进行内容适应性补偿,或者模型的Stochastic补偿而不适应上下文.
与此相反,GR使用解码器上已有的 en上下文来参数化一种适应空间位置和图像内容的精细分布,而不增加有效载荷,而适应性扰动则为基因重建提供了培训规范化.

To improve low-bitrate reconstruction in lightweight GIC, we introduce Guided Refinement (GR) after RVQ recovery.
GR uses entropy context to define a Gaussian refinement distribution around the recovered latent that adapts to spatial location and image content.
During joint training, sampling from this distribution introduces adaptive perturbations that provide latent noise regularization.

blocks.en:
EF-LIC [ 6 ] reported that P-RVQ takes 9.16 ms on Kodak, accounting for 52.0% of the measured 17.62 ms encoder latency and forming a major encoder latency bottleneck.
For fast inference, we reorganize P-RVQ execution while preserving its greedy quantization process.

blocks.en:
Under the same Torch FP32 backend and precision, the reorganized P-RVQ implementation achieves a 3.14 × 3.14\times average speedup over the original implementation across the 16 evaluated stage count and resolution settings.
This matched comparison isolates the gain from the algebraic reorganization, which accounts for 23.54 % 23.54\% of the total encoder latency reduction.
The CUDA FP16 implementation further increases the average speedup to 7.15 × 7.15\times relative to the original FP32 implementation.
At the highest evaluated Kodak BPP, compression-only P-RVQ reaches an 18.80 × 18.80\times speedup, and the complete P-RVQ acceleration accounts for 31.28 % 31.28\% of the total encoder latency reduction.

这种匹配的比较将代数重组的收益隔离开来,代数重组占编码器空降总量的23.54% 23.54% 。

blocks.en:
Our implementation largely follows EF-LIC [ 6 ] , with a GR head added before synthesis and P-RVQ execution reorganized as described above. Appendix B provides the complete architecture and codebook settings.
For fast inference, the highly optimized implementation further uses fused CUDA operators following DCVC-UF [ 27 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们的执行工作主要是在EF-LIC[6]之后,在合成和P-RVQ执行前加上GR头,如上文所述。 附 录 B提供了完整的架构和编码本设置.
对于快速推论,高度优化的实施进一步使用了DCVC-UF[27]之后的已引信的CUDA操作器.

blocks.en:

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en:
Our evaluation spans 0.0356 to 0.1426 BPP, with the lowest point below the 0.05 BPP ultra-low bitrate threshold [ 47 , 46 ] .
Extending lightweight GIC to even lower bitrates requires greater decoder generative capacity as less fine detail is transmitted.
Future work can strengthen lightweight priors and synthesis capacity while retaining fast inference.
Our latency results characterize the complete deployed codec, including P-RVQ reorganization and CUDA acceleration.
We do not claim the fastest backbone-only FP32 inference under identical backends.
Comparisons retain official or released implementations and available acceleration paths, reflecting system-level performance.
blocks.zh:
我们的评价跨度为0.0356至0.1426 BPP,最低点低于0.05 BPP超低比特率阈值[47,46].
将轻量级GIC扩展至更低的比特速率需要更大的解码基因能力,因为传输的细微细节较少.
今后的工作可以加强轻量前科和合成能力,同时保留快速推论.
我们的延迟结果体现了完整的已部署的编码器,包括P-RVQ重组和CUDA加速。
我们并不声称在相同的后端下只有FP32的骨干推论最快.
比较保留了官方或发布的执行和可用的加速路径,反映了系统层面的性能.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced GR-GIC , an efficient GIC combining GR and reorganized P-RVQ for competitive reconstruction performance and fast inference.
GR refines quantized latents using entropy context, while adaptive perturbations provide latent noise regularization during training.
Reorganized P-RVQ replaces serial high dimensional residual updates with low dimensional lookups to reduce sequential computation.
Experiments across four datasets show consistent gains in LPIPS, DISTS, and FID over OneDC, together with fast inference on both an NVIDIA A100 and Jetson Orin NX.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了GR-GIC,一个高效的GIC结合了GR和重组后的P-RVQ,用于竞争性的重建业绩和快速推论.
GR利用演化环境精细化了潜在物,而适应性扰动则在培训期间提供了潜在噪声的规范化。
重新组织P-RVQ将序列高维余量更新替换为低维查看,以减少顺序计算.
跨越四个数据集的实验显示,LPIPS、DISTS和FID在OneDC上取得了一致的收益,同时快速推论了NVIDIA A100和Jetson Orin NX两种数据。

blocks.en:
Checkpoint conversion materializes the stacked search projection, codeword norms, codebook transposes, reconstruction tables, and the cross stage lookup tables in Equation 12 .
At runtime, the source projections in Equation 14 are evaluated with one matrix multiplication.

在运行时间,用一个矩阵乘法评价方程式14中的源预测.

blocks.en:
A fused CUDA kernel then processes the ordered P-RVQ stages.
Candidate dot products, distance evaluation, parallel reduction for index selection, table lookup, and updates to the later low dimensional states are performed within one kernel launch.
The kernel preserves the ordered greedy decisions while parallelizing candidate evaluation and the updates to future search states.
This avoids separate search launches at every stage and avoids materializing complete distance and update tensors.
blocks.zh:
一个熔化的CUDA内核然后处理订购的P-RVQ级.
候选点产品,距离评价,索引选择的并行减少,表格检索,以及后期低维状态的更新都是在一个内核发射内进行.
内核保留了命令的贪婪决定,同时将候选人的评价和更新与未来的搜索状态平行.
这避免了每个阶段的单独搜索发射,也避免了实现完整的距离,更新的百分数.

blocks.en:
When reconstruction is required, a second kernel gathers the selected high dimensional vectors, sums them, and writes the reconstructed output.
During decompression, these reconstruction operations are further combined with the surrounding codec operations.
This codec integration lies outside the isolated P-RVQ timing reported below.
blocks.zh:
当需要重建时,第二个内核会收集选定的高维矢量,将它们汇总,并写入重建的输出.
在解压期间,这些重建行动与周围的密码行动进一步结合.
这种编码集成位于下文报告的孤立的P-RVQ时间之外。

blocks.en: C.1 Datasets and Objective Evaluation
blocks.zh: C.1 数据集和目标评价

blocks.en:
Kodak, Tecnick, DIV2K validation, and CLIC 2020 Professional test contain 24, 100, 100, and 250 images, respectively.
All reconstructed images are evaluated at their original image resolution.
blocks.zh:
科达克、特尼克、DIV2 K验证,和CLIC 2020专业测试分别包含24,100,100和250幅图像.
所有重建的图像都按其原始图像分辨率进行评估.

blocks.en:
We use standardized objective metrics as the primary quantitative evaluation.
Subjective user studies can provide complementary perceptual evidence, but their results depend on the participant population, viewing conditions, presentation protocol, and selected test images, and naturally exhibit observer variability.
These factors make subjective scores less suitable for reproducible comparisons across many methods, datasets, and operating points.
Standardized objective metrics instead provide repeatable measurements under a fixed evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh:
我们使用标准化的客观衡量标准作为初级定量评估。
主观用户研究可以提供互补的感知证据,但其结果取决于参与者群,查看条件,展示协议,以及选定的测试图像,并自然表现出观察者可变性.
这些因素使得主观分数更不适合在许多方法,数据集,操作点之间进行可复制的比较.
相反,标准化的目标衡量标准根据固定评价协议提供可重复的衡量标准。

blocks.en:
This practice is also common in generative image compression.
Representative methods including MS-ILLM, GLC, Control-GIC, DLF, OneDC, OSCAR, and RDVQ primarily evaluate reconstruction using objective metrics such as LPIPS, DISTS, and FID without reporting a subjective user study [ 33 , 21 , 26 , 41 , 42 , 18 , 23 ] .
We therefore use LPIPS and DISTS to measure reference-based perceptual similarity, PSNR to measure pixel fidelity, and FID to measure distribution-level alignment, together with qualitative reconstructions for visual comparison.
blocks.zh:
这种做法在基因图像压缩中也很常见.
包括MS-ILLM、GLC、Control-GIC、DLF、OneDC、OSCAR和RDVQ在内的代表性方法主要使用客观的衡量标准,如LPIPS、DISTS和FID,在没有报告主观用户研究的情况下评价重建[33、21、26、41、42、18、23]。
因此,我们使用LPIPS和DISTS来测量基于参考的感官相似性,PSNR来测量像素忠诚性,FID来测量分布级的一致性,同时进行视觉对比的质量重建.

blocks.en:
LPIPS is computed with pretrained VGG features after mapping RGB inputs to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] .
DISTS receives RGB inputs in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , and PSNR is computed in RGB.
blocks.zh:

DISTS在[0,1] [0,1]中接收RGB输入,PSNR在RGB中计算.

blocks.en:
Following the patch evaluation protocol used for low-rate generative image compression [ 21 ] , we compute FID from local image patches.
Reference and reconstructed RGB images in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] are rounded to unsigned 8-bit values and passed to the TorchMetrics implementation of FID [ 10 , 19 ] .

blocks.en: C.2 Runtime and Model Cost Protocol
blocks.zh: C.2 运行时间和示范费用议定书

blocks.en:
All A100 codec runtimes use batch size one on one NVIDIA A100 GPU.
For GR-GIC , CPU payload processing is performed on an AMD EPYC 7763.
blocks.zh:
所有A100编码运行时间都使用一个NVIDIA A100 GPU上的批量尺寸1.
对于GR-GIC,CPU的有效载荷处理是在AMD EMYC 7763上进行的.

blocks.en:
The latency comparison retains the numerical precision, inference backend, and acceleration path provided by each available implementation.
The reported values therefore characterize realized system latency rather than architecture-only speed under an identical backend.
EF-LIC and ProGIC follow their published FP32 evaluation settings [ 6 , 7 ] , while the remaining methods retain their released inference settings.
blocks.zh:
耐久性比较保留了数字精度,推论后端,以及每个可用执行提供的加速路径.
因此,所报告的数值是同一后端下已实现的系统延缓性而不是仅架构速度的特点。
EF-LIC和ProGIC遵循其发布的FP32评价设置[6,7],而其余方法则保留其发布的推论设置.

blocks.en:
The highly optimized implementation of GR-GIC combines reorganized P-RVQ with fused CUDA operators following DCVC-UF [ 27 ] .
It uses FP16 execution and CUDA Graphs together with custom kernels for quantization and reconstruction.
The remaining convolution operations use optimized ATen and cuDNN kernels.
blocks.zh:
GR-GIC的高度优化实施将重组后的P-RVQ与DCVC-UF[27]之后的已引信的CUDA运营商结合起来.
它使用FP16执行和CUDA Graphs以及自定义内核进行定量和重建.
剩下的演化操作使用优化的ATen和cuDNN内核.

blocks.en:
The reported encoding and decoding times cover the complete codec path.
Encoding includes index generation, transfer to the CPU, and bitstream packing.
Decoding includes bitstream unpacking, transfer to the GPU, index recovery, one GR realization, and image synthesis.
Timing starts after model loading, input construction, and CUDA Graph capture.
We use two warmup runs followed by ten synchronized repetitions.
blocks.zh:
所报告的编码和解码时间涵盖了完整的编码路径.
编码包括索引生成,传输到CPU,以及位流包装.
解码包括位流解析,转移到GPU,索引恢复,一个GR实现,以及图像合成.
时机从模型加载,输入构造,和CUDA Graph捕获开始.
我们用两个热身,然后十次同步重复。

blocks.en:
For GR-GIC , the reported latency and model cost are averaged over four independently trained operating points at 0.0356 0.0356 , 0.0713 0.0713 , 0.1069 0.1069 , and 0.1426 0.1426 BPP.
The same averaging convention is used for the A100 and Jetson results.
blocks.zh:
就GR-GIC而言,所报告的延迟和模型成本平均超过四个经过独立培训的操作点,分别为0.0356 0.0356、0.0713 0.0713、0.1069 0.1069和0.1426 BPP。
A100和Jetson结果采用同样的平均惯例。

blocks.en:
We report the parameter count of the complete codec deployed at one evaluated operating point.
Each of the four independently trained GR-GIC checkpoints contains 79.389M parameters.
The reported 79.389M therefore represents one deployed model rather than the combined storage of all four checkpoints.
blocks.zh:
我们报告在一个评估的操作点部署的完整编码器的参数数。
四个受过独立培训的GR-GIC检查站各有79.389M参数。
报告的79 389份 管理人员 因此,这是一个已部署的模式,而不是合并储存所有四个检查站。

blocks.en:
This convention is also applied to methods that use separate checkpoints for different target rates.
Among the compared methods, ResULIC, StableCodec, RDEIC, OneDC, MS-ILLM, DLF, DiT-IC, AEIC, and CoD-Lite use separately trained or fine-tuned model weights for different operating points [ 25 , 47 , 29 , 42 , 33 , 41 , 36 , 46 , 22 ] .
blocks.zh:
该公约也适用于对不同目标费率使用单独检查站的方法。
在比较方法中,ResULIC、StableCodec、RDEIC、OneDC、MS-ILLM、DLF、DiT-IC、AEIC和CoD-Lite对不同的操作点分别使用经过培训或微调的模型权重[25、47、29、42、33、41、36、46、22]。

blocks.en:
We use the same parameter accounting rule for both types of codec.
The tables report the complete model required for the evaluated operating point and do not sum multiple checkpoints across the rate curve.
The storage required to retain all supported operating points is a separate deployment property from the parameter count of one deployed codec.
blocks.zh:
我们使用相同的参数会计规则 两种代码。
表格报告评价的作业点所需的完整模式,没有将跨费率曲线的多个检查站相加。
保留所有支持的操作点所需的存储是一个单独的部署属性,与一个已部署的编码器的参数计数不同。

blocks.en:
FLOPs are measured for one encoder and decoder pass with batch size one on the corresponding PyTorch FP32 path under the profiler-supported operator scope.
We count one multiply-accumulate operation as two FLOPs.
The same pass definition and arithmetic convention are used for all methods.
Peak memory denotes the maximum allocated GPU memory including the loaded model and active codec buffers.
blocks.zh:
FLOP是在配置器支持的操作员范围下,在相应的PyTorch FP32路径上用批量尺寸1的编码器和解码器通过一个编码器进行测量.
我们计算一个乘积操作 作为两个FLOP。
所有方法都采用同样的通过定义和算术惯例。
峰值内存表示最大分配的GPU内存,包括加载的模型和活动编码缓冲器.

blocks.en: C.3 Baseline Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: C.3 基线评价议定书

blocks.en:
Except where noted, we evaluate released checkpoints on the same NVIDIA A100 with batch size one.
Each method follows the coding and inference procedure provided by its official implementation.
blocks.zh:
除已注意到的情况外,我们评价同一批批号为1的NVIDIA A100上已放行的检查站。
每种方法都遵循其正式实施所提供的编码和推断程序。

blocks.en:
EF-LIC and ProGIC use their published FP32 settings [ 6 , 7 ] .
OneDC follows its official path with BF16 autocast for the feedforward and codec networks while retaining the large VAE in FP32 [ 42 ] .
CoD-Lite uses its official 0.0312 0.0312 BPP checkpoint with BF16 inference [ 22 ] .
Under our full codec profiling scope, this checkpoint gives 771.69G FLOPs at 512 × 768 512\times 768 .
The CoD-Lite paper reports 535 kMAC per pixel, corresponding to 420.74G FLOPs under our arithmetic convention.
We use our common profiling scope for the system comparison and retain the published value as a separate reference.
Control-GIC uses its official granularity control, which we enumerate at intervals of 0.01, together with official tiling on DIV2K and CLIC 2020 [ 26 ] .
blocks.zh:
EF-LIC和ProGIC使用其已公布的FP32设置[6,7].
OneDC在FP32[42]中保留了大型VAE的同时,也遵循其官方路径,为feedforward和codec网络使用BF16自动播报.
CoD-Lite使用官方的0.0312 0.0312 BPP检查站,并带有BF16推断[22].
在我们的整个密码剖面范围下,这个检查点以512×768 512\times 768提供771.69G FLOP.
CoD-Lite纸上每像素报告535 kMAC,对应我国算术公约下的420.74G FLOP.
我们使用我们系统比较的共同剖面范围,并保留公布的价值作为单独的参考。
Control-GIC使用它的官方颗粒性控制,我们每隔0.01个时段将它与DIV2K和CLIC 2020[26]上的官方硬盘一起列出.

blocks.en:
For GLC [ 21 ] , the released interface provides analysis and synthesis without a complete bitstream path.
For the high-resolution codec comparison, we additionally use a CompressAI 1.2.6 integration [ 4 ] that produces and decodes the actual bitstream.
blocks.zh:
对于GLC [21],释放的接口提供分析和合成,而无需完整的位流路径.
对于高分辨率的编码比较,我们额外使用一个压缩机AI 1.2.6集成[4],生成并解码实际的位流.

blocks.en: For OSCAR, rate and quality evaluation uses CPU offloading on high-resolution images when required, while the resource tables report the direct execution result [ 18 ] .
blocks.zh: 对OSCAR来说,速率和质量评价在需要时使用CPU在高分辨率图像上卸载,而资源表则报告直接执行结果[18].

blocks.en:
CADC [ 35 ] and PICO [ 38 ] do not provide the corresponding executable models used in our comparison.
We therefore use their published curves or released numerical results only when the metric definition and evaluation range are compatible with ours.
blocks.zh:
CADC[35]和PICO[38]没有提供我们比较时使用的相应可执行模型。
因此,只有在衡量定义和评价范围与我们的一致时,我们才使用它们公布的曲线或公布数字结果。

blocks.en:
For CoD-Lite, measurements from the released implementation differ from the latency values reported in its paper.
At the 1024 × 1920 1024\times 1920 reference resolution, we measure 39.522 ms for encoding and 56.863 ms for decoding, compared with the reported 16 and 24 ms.
We therefore use measurements from the released code under our common hardware and timing protocol rather than mixing measured and separately reported runtime values.
The system comparisons use the official 0.0312 0.0312 BPP checkpoint specified by the published speed evaluation.
blocks.zh:
就CoD-Lite而言,所发布的执行量不同于其文件中报告的延迟值。
在1024×1920 1024\times 1920的参考解析度中,我们测量编码为39.522毫秒,解码为56.863毫秒,而所报告的16和24毫秒.
因此,我们使用我们共同硬件和计时协议下发布的代码的测量,而不是混合测量和单独报告的运行时间值。
系统比较使用公布的速度评价指定的官方0.0312 0.0312 BPP检查站.

At 512 × 768 512\times 768 , the eager PyTorch FP32 implementation encodes in 30.453 ms and decodes in 44.708 ms.

blocks.en:
CADC and PICO do not provide the corresponding executable models used in our comparison.
Following the protocol in Appendix C , we therefore compare against their published curves or released numerical results where the metric definitions and rate ranges are compatible.
blocks.zh:
CADC和PICO没有提供我们比较时使用的相应可执行模型.
因此,在附录C中的协议之后,我们将它们公布的曲线或公布的数字结果进行比较,如果衡量定义和比率范围是相容的。

blocks.en:
At the shared lowest Kodak rate of 0.03564 BPP, interpolation of the published CADC curves gives approximately 23.15 dB PSNR and 0.087 DISTS [ 35 ] .
At the same rate, GR-GIC achieves 23.35 dB PSNR and 0.075 DISTS.
This corresponds to a PSNR increase of approximately 0.20 dB and a DISTS reduction of approximately 0.012.
blocks.zh:
以共享最低的柯达速率0.03564 BPP,对已公布的CADC曲线的插值给出了约23.15 dB PSNR和0.087 DISTS [35].
同样的速度,GR-GIC实现了23.35 dB PSNR和0.075 DISTS.
这相当于PSNR增加约0.20 dB,DISTS减少约0.012.

blocks.en:
CADC reports LPIPS using AlexNet features, while our main evaluation uses VGG features.
We therefore restrict this comparison to the aligned PSNR and DISTS metrics.
blocks.zh:
CADC使用AlexNet功能报告LPIPS,而我们的主要评价则使用VGG功能.
因此,我们仅限于比较经调整的PSNR和DSTS指标。

blocks.en: D.7 GR Inference Stability

blocks.en:
We first evaluate the effect of the sampled perturbation at inference using the protocol in Sec. C.5 .
With the perturbation term removed, the decoder uses only the learned refinement center 𝒚 ^ + 𝜹 \hat{\bm{y}}+\bm{\delta} .

blocks.en: These results support the interpretation in Sec. 4.3 that the adaptive perturbation primarily contributes through training regularization rather than through the particular random realization used at inference.
blocks.zh: 这些结果支持第4.3节的解释,即适应性干扰主要通过培训正规化而不是通过推论中使用的特定随机实现作出贡献。

blocks.en:
We next vary only the decoder seed according to the protocol in Sec. C.5 .
Across ten seeds on Kodak, aggregate LPIPS varies by less than 10 − 4 10^{-4} and FID by less than 10 − 2 10^{-2} .
blocks.zh:

在柯达的10个种子中,LPIPS的总和变化小于10−4 10^{-4}FID小于10−2 10^{-2}.

blocks.en:
The transmitted indices and payload are identical across these runs.

blocks.zh:
所传送的指数和有效载荷在这些飞行中是相同的。
微小的度量变化表明,所报告的总体重建绩效在经过评价的总目标实现中是稳定的。

blocks.en:
We also repeat the Kodak FID computation four times with the reconstructed images and patch extraction fixed.

This confirms that the variation measured above comes from the GR realization rather than repeated execution of the FID estimator.
blocks.zh:
